verdict.rationale: Codegen documents an official Python SDK (codegen-docs-11, -15, -31) as a thin pythonic wrapper around a documented REST API with extensive endpoint reference docs (codegen-docs-16 through -40), plus an official CLI (codegen-probe-3). This gives AI-native users first-party programmatic building blocks for agent automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK usage beyond vendor docs, and no discoverable OpenAPI spec (codegen-probe-2 shows 404s), suggesting the API reference may not be machine-generated/fully standardized.
